top_choice_rationale: P002 has the shortest documented chain from original prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald 2011) to the original experiment (Jarillo-Herrero group 2018: gate-tunable correlated insulating and superconducting states at the magic angle), and the phenomena have been reproduced by many groups with transport and scanning-probe methods. It opened a door to a regime that could not previously be seen or tuned, and the citation can be limited to observed phenomena without claiming the pairing mechanism. Weaknesses are real (field is about eight years old, Yuan Cao cannot be named within three names), so P001 is a close second: mature, reproduced and cleanly attributed, though it is more an invention than a discovery and the 2001-03 priority record is unchecked. P003 follows because of the unsettled credit boundary around Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and overlap with the 2016 prize; a prize is better than no award in all three cases.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001, P002 or P003; departmental links to Johansson (Chalmers) and Mehlig (Gothenburg) are not conflicts. As a transmission electron microscopist I would step back from aberration-corrected electron optics (B012), which is not in this slate.
